en.sayed-ali-raza: remember death very much and the place where you have to go suddenly and reach after death, so that when it comes you are already on your guard against it and have prepared yourself for it and it does not come to you all of a sudden and surprise you.
Beware, lest you become deceived by the leanings of the people towards worldly attraction and their rushing upon it.
Allāh has warned you about it and the world has informed you of its mortal character and unveiled to you its evils.
